title: Power Plant and System Monitoring Instruments
src: R.K. Bali — Air Navigation, Part II Ch 8

qs.q: What type of sensor is used to measure the output of a low pressure booster pump:
qs.ex: Book's key. Low pressures are more usually measured with bellows or a capsule; Bourdon tubes suit high pressures.

qs.q: The two principal types of direct reading pressure gauge are:
o: the Bourdon tube type and the capsule operated type.
manifold pressure type and engine pressure type.

qs.q: Which of the following are used to measure temperature? 1. Thermocouple 2. Resistance 3. Reactance 4. Mercury

An aircraft has a compensated capacitance fuel contents gauging system and is refuelled so that the total fuel contents are 76 000 kg at 18 °C and an SG of 0.81. Whilst the aircraft is parked the temperature increases to 26 °C and the SG becomes 0.80. The indicated fuel contents have:
qs.ex: Book's key. A compensated capacitance system indicates mass, which has not changed, so many sources give 'remained the same'.
